-- True when the path, after resolving "." and "..", stays inside its base directory.
-- Absolute paths, empty names and any path that climbs above the base are not inside.
stays_inside(path: str) -> bool =
  ex stays_inside("a.txt") == True
  ex stays_inside("sub/../a.txt") == True
  ex stays_inside("sub/b/c.txt") == True
  ex stays_inside("..") == False
  ex stays_inside("../x") == False
  ex stays_inside("sub/../../x") == False
  ex stays_inside("/etc/passwd") == False
  ex stays_inside("") == False
  for c in path.chars()
    if c == "\\" or c == "\0"
      return False
  var depth = 0
  var first = True
  for seg in path.split("/")
    if seg == ""
      if first
        return False
      continue
    first = False
    if seg == "."
      continue
    if seg == ".."
      depth -= 1
      if depth < 0
        return False
    else
      depth += 1
  depth > 0

-- Text of the file `path` under the directory `notes`, or "" when the path
-- escapes `notes`, or when the file is missing or unreadable.
read_public(path: str) -> str uses fs =
  post stays_inside(path) or out == ""
  ex read_public("..") == ""
  ex read_public("../secret.txt") == ""
  ex read_public("sub/../../x") == ""
  ex read_public("/etc/passwd") == ""
  if not stays_inside(path)
    return ""
  with fs = fs.sub("notes")
    fs.read(path) else ""
